verses.safarun-yusamma-sayyida-l-asfari-c1-v1: safaru yusammā sayyida l-ʾasfāri waziyāratu ṭābat ʿalā z-zuwwāri
verses.safarun-yusamma-sayyida-l-asfari-c1-v2: wajamāʿatu taqfū māʾāthira man lahu fī l-ʿālamīna māʾāthiru l-ʾakhyāri
verses.safarun-yusamma-sayyida-l-asfari-c1-v3: waʿaqīdatu tandakku ḥawla bisāṭihā mā fī bisāṭi l-ʾarḍi min ʾaḥjāri
verses.safarun-yusamma-sayyida-l-asfari-c1-v4: wamaḥabbahu tanqādu minhā lith-tharā rusulu s-samāʾi biṣuḥbahi l-ʾaḥbāri
verses.safarun-yusamma-sayyida-l-asfari-c1-v5: hadhī qurayyātu lahā zuʿamāʾuhā wal-yumnu fī zuʿamāʾihā l-ʾabrāri
verses.safarun-yusamma-sayyida-l-asfari-c1-v6: yastawqifūna r-rakba kulla daqīqati war-rakbu taḥta riʿāyati wajiwāri
verses.safarun-yusamma-sayyida-l-asfari-c1-v7: wal-jiddu fīhim sunnatu marḍiyyatu wal-jiddu la yakhlū mina l-ʾadhkāri
verses.safarun-yusamma-sayyida-l-asfari-c1-v8: ḥattā ntahā dhāka l-masīru bikullihim lin-nahri wahwa yatīmatu l-ʾanhāri
verses.safarun-yusamma-sayyida-l-asfari-c1-v9: wash-shamsu tadnū lil-ghurūbi kaʾannahā dhahabu ʾurīqa biqaṣʿahi min nāri
verses.safarun-yusamma-sayyida-l-asfari-c1-v10: wal-māʾu yarqubuhā biʿayni ṣafāʾihā wal-jawwu yulbisuhā bikulli ʾizāri
verses.safarun-yusamma-sayyida-l-asfari-c1-v11: wallaylu yantaẓiru l-ʾawāmira minhumā ʾinna l-ʾawāmira minhumā biqarāri
verses.safarun-yusamma-sayyida-l-asfari-c1-v12: wan-nāsu ḥawla ḍ-ḍaffatayni kaʾannahum bayna l-qawāribi ʿaskaru biḥiṣāri
verses.safarun-yusamma-sayyida-l-asfari-c1-v13: ṣif lī l-manāẓira ʾidh ʿabarnā naḥwahum wal-ʿabru ẓahra safīnati bisiwāri
verses.safarun-yusamma-sayyida-l-asfari-c1-v14: kayfa n-nuzūlu birūsu baʿda tanazzuhi war-rīḥu takhdumuhum maʿa l-ʾaysāri
verses.safarun-yusamma-sayyida-l-asfari-c1-v15: hadhā biʾidhni min khalīfati māliki ʾinna l-khalīfata zīnatu l-ʾaqṭāri
verses.safarun-yusamma-sayyida-l-asfari-c1-v16: lazāla yasrī fayḍuhu fī ẓillihim wayaʿʿumuhum lil-khuldi bil-ʾasrāri
verses.safarun-yusamma-sayyida-l-asfari-c1-v17: lazāla yaqḍī llāhu khāliqunā bihi ma nāʾa fī himami wafī ʾawṭāri
